name: Mousense
look: a chubby cream mouse sitting up with its eyes closed and nose in the air, long whiskers, big round dark ears, a buck tooth and pink paws and tail
entry: Its eyes stay shut from the day it hatches. It feels its way about with its long whiskers, which can pick up the flutter of a moth's wings across a meadow, so sneaking up on it is near impossible.
how: Wild: common in plains, grasslands, forests and hills.
